spec.description: Elevation above sea level for up to 100 coordinates, from the 90 m Copernicus DEM.

latitude.description: Latitudes of the points, in degrees; one per `longitude` entry.

longitude.description: Longitudes of the points, in degrees; one per `latitude` entry.

response.title: Elevations
response.description: One elevation per requested point, in request order.

elevation.description: Elevation of each point in metres.

notes: Lists are sent as repeated query keys (`latitude=52.52&latitude=48.85`), the form the official Open-Meteo clients use; the documentation shows the comma-separated form, which the API accepts as well.
`apikey` is redacted because the transport adds it to the query on the commercial tier; the free tier sends none.
